questions.concept: Separate aggregate sort key from summed weight
questions.context:
Convex 1.41.0, @convex-dev/aggregate 0.2.2. Stored transactions have numeric `happenedAt` and `amount`. Inserts already synchronize full documents. A query calls `transactionAggregate.sum(ctx, { bounds: { lower: { key: start, inclusive: true }, upper: { key: end, inclusive: false } } })`. Complete the second constructor argument:
```ts
new TableAggregate<{ Key: number; DataModel: DataModel; TableName: "transactions" }>(components.aggregate, CONFIG);
```
questions.question: Which configuration makes this query sum amounts for transactions in [start, end)?

options.rationale: The bounds select time keys and the weighted aggregate adds amount.
Applies the time bounds to amounts instead of timestamps.
No amount weight is stored; sum does not infer a field named amount.
Selects the right interval but sums timestamps instead of amounts.
